The two claims, on screen

1 · Input in time — one button starts, stops and adds time; the span is the sum of segments; every press reaches every phone; a claim never exceeds the clock; a minute is ♡ or 웃, never both.
2 · Local minimum wage authorizes value — 웃 = M × T, currency-free; the plan (hours × M) accepted by all three before Start; each contributor elects their own floor and settles in their own currency at the greater of vintage and current (D9); no floor is invented.

F1 · Compose — the task and its plan (2 h × 3 = 6 웃), the pod default place

F2 · Invite — QR, code, ● live

F3 · Agreed — each elected their own locality and approved the plan

F4 · Active — three ready, the clock button not yet running

F5 · Active — Start · Stop · Add time: two segments, replicated to every phone

F6 · Record — one outcome from each of the three

F7 · Audit — claims capped to the clock, cross-witnessed, M locked

F8 · Closed — plan → actual, each at their own floor, D9, stamped

The fleet proves the mint. The mint does not fail; its carriers drift, in four classes.
